contract.task_clause:
Which of the following best describes the snob appeal fallacy?
Option A: reasoning that a claim is true based only on the evidence that it has been made so often.
Option B: arguing someone should accept a claim based only on the evidence that he or she has the favorable characteristics to understand the truth of the claim.
Option C: arguing a claim should be accepted based only on evidence that unidentified authorities accept it.
Option D: arguing that someone should accept an idea or product based only on evidence that prestigious people accept it, or that non-prestigious people reject it.
